text: Hey Ofek - if you have pretty strong proofs for everything else (i.e. plenty of photos, reference letters, whatsapp chats, a detailed explanation letter) then personally I personally would avoid the translation expense and potential problems that could come from providing this document, and just describe the fact that you stayed together in your shared explanation letter. If they want additional proof, they can ask for it. But up to you. But generally, this type of optional document shouldn't need a notarial translation and a one month stay is not so likely to require a new police certificate.
